blocks.x: When did you first meet Bill?

He used to live in Tenafly, which is not far from here and he was assigned to the Cap Shanks. I met him early on in the Glenn Miller, but only in passing. I was introduced to him, we talked a bit, but it was never very much. When it came to Shanks, somehow we would spend evenings together. I would go down--he could stay at home and go down to the Army and appear once a month for his check. He had it set up that way.

He was the original good soldier schweik (phonetic spelling). Ask Eddie Bert the story, because Eddie was with him through this whole thing. It's very funny; I'm not familiar enough to give the story, but if you ever come out to Bill, get Eddie Bert to tell you.
One story is the lieutenant used to come down and plead, please, come on, show up, so that you can get paid. They were supposed to court martial him or something.
I got Bill then to go to Wolpe. That was after the war though. But it was during these house visits that we used to make just to say hello, really.
I guess it was '47, '48 they went off to Europe.
Wolpe's brother was a consultant, a political consultant, for Time and Life and they helped them get around Paris at the time.

So he came back in '51 and Johnny got him to do the musical--while I was in the hospital in '50 I got a letter from him suggesting we start a band. We can't get along any other way, we might as well prop one another up, which is pretty much what it was.
